paragraphs: I am Longteng Zhang, a final-year PhD candidate in the Thrust of Data Science and Analytics at [HKUST(GZ)](https://www.hkust-gz.edu.cn/), advised by [Xiaowen Chu](https://sites.google.com/view/chuxiaowen/home) and [Luo Qiong](https://cse.hkust.edu.hk/~luo/). My research interest lies broadly in optimization and AI topics.
My recent research focuses on building efficient systems capable of reasoning and optimization in long-horizon and complex environments.
